intent.proves: At least one visible Authentication app shows the profile selector after sign-in.
intent.scope: active UserAuthentication paragraphs on active pages; ListUserProfiles setting key observed on a 10.29.x baseline

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph p JOIN Page g ON g.PageId = p.ParagraphPageId WHERE p.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND p.ParagraphShowParagraph = 1 AND g.PageDeleted = 0 AND g.PageActive = 1 AND p.ParagraphModuleSystemName = 'UserAuthentication' AND p.ParagraphModuleSettings LIKE '%<ListUserProfiles>1</ListUserProfiles>%'
